result.title: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
result.summary: We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. In attempts read side by side with the base model's on tasks each adapter newly solves, the base model's failures recur in a few modes, and each adapter does more often what the base model missed: the tool-use adapter finds the data and the rules before acting, the coding adapter writes its own test or scratch files on SWE-bench Pro V2, the constraints adapter carries earlier turns into its answers, the chart adapter measures the marks in code, and the document adapter reads AutomationBench's spreadsheets.

AI.brief_summary: 用 CISPO 与 rank-32 LoRA 在五个专家构建任务集（软件工程、复杂约束、长程工具使用、图表理解、企业文档）上分别对 Nemotron 3.5 Super 做无监督阶段的 RL 后训练，报告十二个基准的增益，并对比各适配器相对基座的行为变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其图表与文档子任务及失败模式分析显示模型更常先取数据与规则再行动、用代码量取图中标记，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据获取与「LOOK」步骤及监督设计的线索，但论文不涉及内部 latent 状态或表示层面的分析。
